hero.title: Always Stay in Light Mode
hero.subtitle: No matter what your system settings are
hero.description: A simple yet powerful browser extension that keeps your web browsing experience in comfortable light mode, even if your system is set to dark mode.

features.title: Why Choose Always Light Mode?
features.description: Our extension provides a simple and effective solution for enjoying a light mode reading experience in any situation

override.title: Override System Settings
override.description: No matter what mode your system is set to, web pages always remain in light mode, ensuring a consistent browsing experience

eyeStrain.title: Reduce Eye Strain
eyeStrain.description: Light mode is often better for reading in many situations, reducing eye fatigue, especially in bright environments

oneClick.title: One-Click Activation
oneClick.description: Takes effect immediately after installation, no complex settings, simple and easy to use

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Always Light Mode intelligently overrides website dark mode settings to ensure you always get a light browsing experience

install.title: Install the Extension
install.description: Download and install the Always Light Mode extension from the Chrome Web Store

activate.title: Automatic Activation
activate.description: The extension automatically detects website color modes and applies light mode overrides

enjoy.title: Enjoy Light Experience
enjoy.description: Immediately enjoy light mode on all websites without any additional settings

cta.title: Try Always Light Mode Now
cta.description: Join thousands of users enjoying a more comfortable web browsing experience. Download for free, takes effect immediately!
